# SCI-FLT-MATCHED v0.1 — Author Conventions And Ownership

Status: sanitized author input

## Identities

Requested, effective, observation-resolved, realized, and published state are
distinct. Every product binds an immutable exact parent, parent grouping,
method generation, template, weighting state, operator realization, response,
support/validity, units/calibration, uncertainty availability, lifecycle, and
provenance. Unavailable is never numerical zero or silent fallback.

Observation and coadd parents are distinct. Numerical computability does not
establish scientific validity. Unknown covariance is not zero; a diagonal or
pointwise representation is not independence; a reciprocal is not precision.

## Ownership

`SCI-FLT-MATCHED` owns its template-amplitude transformation, learned-once
state definition, realization, response, support consequences, products,
lifecycle, failure, and named-use policies.

MAP owns the immutable admitted parent map bundle, its grouping, WCS/frame,
support/validity facts, response/calibration provenance, and exact contributing
observations for a coadd. FLT may consume but not rewrite those facts.

The template producer owns the exact materialized template-response product.
CAL/BEAM own calibrated transfer, amplitude convention inputs, beam lineage,
and calibration covariance. FLT owns only their declared use and resulting
template-amplitude response.

NOI owns realization generation and empirical uncertainty meanings. FLT owns
the exact frozen transformation supplied for compatible members. Fixed-state
and per-member-relearned ensembles are different methods and cannot mix.

VAL may register and evaluate immutable profiles. FLT owns the producer facts,
named-use policies, required actions, and failure consequences supplied to
those profiles.

FRUIT owns its future source model, subtraction/add-back, recurrence, learning,
stopping/restart/selection, response, uncertainty, and interpretation. FLT
owns preservation of its first-class scientific handoff, not FRUIT behavior.

No present SRC boundary is created. Source analysis is simply outside scope.
